title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Free in Christ and Still Be Tempted
caption:
Being tempted doesn't mean the freedom didn't work. It means you're still in the fight, and you're fighting it as a free man now.

Don't confuse the urge with the fall. Move fast. Bring it into the light. And watch the gaps between the hard nights get longer, because God finishes what He starts.

Save this for the night you need it.

#faith #godlyman #freedom #christianmen
